test_title: PYST 8: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’**.

__No sooner__ I get the message, I shall pass it on to you.
solution:
The answer is **'As soon as'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In the given sentence, we are talking about two events happening one after another.
 
• The first part is in the present tense while the second part is in the future tense.
 
• Since we are talking about an event in the future. it will be suitable to use the conjunction 'as soon as'.

Hence the correct sentence is: *As soon as__ I get the message, I shall pass it on to you.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** *

__
 
• No sooner is often used with past perfect or simple past but never with present and future tense.
 
• Example in a sentence:
 
 
• *No sooner__ had I stepped outside for lunch break than I received a call from my supervisor*.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 

__
 
• the usage of 'As soon as' in a sentence is followed by a noun or adjective immediately.
 
• The usage of 'No sooner' in a sentence is followed by a verb immediately.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **Hint__** 

 
• The choice of conjunction in a sentence can be decided by noticing the tense following and preceding the conjunction
